_readme: Venues the league site does not list (training grounds) or lists without footwear notes. Keyed by exact venue name. notes use the league's own 'area | footwear | surface' shape so the same parser reads them. A scraped venue with the same name keeps its league address and gains these notes when it has none. arenaAliases rewrites CUSA (RAMP) arena names into the league field wording so the same venue and footwear rules apply. titleNames gives each venue the short name used in calendar titles; an empty string means the field name alone is enough (MaxWell, where most games are).
